title: The Emotion Scam
evidence_boundary: Constructed-emotion and predictive-interoception accounts propose that brains construct emotion categories from body signals, context, memory, and prediction. This does not mean emotions are fake, fully voluntary, or that outside harm is irrelevant.
desired_movement: From believing other people directly insert emotions into us to noticing the larger internal construction process without blaming the experiencer.
grounding: Feet, jaw, breath, and the ordinary room restore agency without denying pain.
invitation: Next time a symbol lights you up, what changes when you ask: who is actually behind the booth?
